App._comment: WebBaseUrl is the public origin of the Next.js frontend, used to build outbound links in emails and notifications. Override per environment via App__WebBaseUrl (e.g. http://localhost:3000 in dev). Defaults to the production domain when unset.

Legal._comment: Published versions of the legal documents, as ISO dates. These are recorded verbatim on every consent row in identity.user_consents, so they must be bumped whenever the text of /terms or /privacy materially changes. Never edit a version in place: a new text means a new version string, otherwise old consent rows silently start pointing at wording nobody agreed to.

Jwt._refreshComment: Refresh token lifetime in days. Held to the same 30 days as the next-auth session cookie so the two never disagree about when a session has ended. Refresh tokens live in Redis: flushing Redis signs everybody out.

Google._comment: From Google Cloud Console > APIs & Services > Credentials. ClientId is also the audience for ID token validation.

Apple._comment: ClientId = Service ID from Apple Developer (e.g. co.za.aptiverse.web). Used as the expected audience when validating Apple ID tokens server-side.

EmailSettings._comment: AWS SES SMTP in eu-west-1 (af-south-1 has NO SES SMTP endpoint, see infra/terraform/ses). Username/Password are SES SMTP credentials (IAM access key id + region-derived password), injected via EmailSettings__Username/Password env vars in dev (.env) and prod, NOT committed here.
